## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1d5f769c821a34dbcb5695598d4f160e4c3e09b5`
Card: #31424 (rulings 6722023475 rules 1–4, 6722123324 rules 5–7)
Ordered-by: domain:skills#2 (`session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw`); dev report 6722660089 (names the pre-rework head 7beda2be; this record is for the current head after the rework and the `origin/main` 6f9f0086 merge)
Local-runs: none. Read-only: PR body and diff (+27/−24, 5 files), both ruling records and the card, claim 6722459395 and amendment 6722677217, the five files at `main` and at the head via the contents API, `git grep` over `.claude/**` at the head for every named survivor and for stale duplicates, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` CEILINGS at the head, check-runs on the head (23 success · 21 skipped · 0 red). The seat's 21-gate sweep at this head stands on the seat's word; the counts below are my own.
Scope: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` · `references/lanes/devx.md` · `references/lanes/server.md` · `references/lanes/spec.md` · `references/lanes/skills.md` (all five Tier S `.claude/**` hits, the whole diff). Cited for the survivor checks: SKILL.md:161, :170–171, :181, :186, :236, :238, :270, :276; `references/execution-duties.md`:11, :120; `references/triage-duties.md`:17; `references/lanes/qa.md`:2, :28; `references/dispatch-runbook.md`:173–174; `references/coordinator.md`:38; `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`:297–298; AGENTS.md:353, §Post-Task Checklist step 3, §Writing a `--self-test`.

### ① Rules 1–7: each written once, matching its record, nothing added
- Rule 1 → `devx.md`:12–13: lane by package not by trigger, a one-package `content/docs` page rides that package's lane 「同 `domain:ui` 行」; devx keeps `apps/docs`, nav `meta.json`, the references pipeline and sweeps spanning two or more lanes. Matches the record word for word in substance. Pointers: SKILL.md devx row (`content/docs` 横切, 见 `lanes/devx.md`), `server.md`:18, `spec.md`:11 (references pipeline removed from spec tooling; `spec.md`:9 still gives the regenerated references output to its source PR, which is the record's sense).
- Rule 2 → `spec.md`:12–18: ownership stays spec but the listed riders may ride a product PR; child card at first touch with `Blocked-by:`; the definition (objects, fields, flow, views, permissions, settings manifests; widening/narrowing an acceptance set; adding/retiring a property); the riders (error-code ledger rows, platform name registries, `contracts/`, JSDoc/describe, tests); the `protocol:*` backstop; `Metadata-protocol:` not decisive alone. All six clauses of the record, none beyond. Pointers: SKILL.md:175 fifth channel, `server.md`:6, `skills.md`:12 (same backstop shape).
- Rule 3 → `devx.md`:14; rule 4 → `devx.md`:15; the SKILL.md devx row drops the 「接线、CI 性能」 qualifier and the no-owner row gains 「测试基建见 devx 行」. The record's aside 「Tier H already forces a separate PR」 is a fact, not a rule, and is rightly not written.
- Rule 5 → `skills.md`:10–12; rule 6 → `skills.md`:13–15, including 「新增门禁默认否照旧」. The record's four examples for rule 5 are not written; they illustrate the test 「改了作者或 agent 被教的内容」, which is written.
- Rule 7 → `devx.md`:7–10: the charter, the six metrics in the record's order, the false-green definition, and the rules-to-skills / tooling-to-devx split. **One bullet of the record is not written anywhere: 「Triage shows these metrics in the daily dashboard's lane section.」** It is a triage display duty, so its home is `triage-duties.md` or the dashboard's own spec, neither of which the records' Execution lists name; the PR body says the dashboard display is out of scope per the order. See ⑤.
- Nothing added: every new line in the diff traces to a clause of one of the two records or is a pointer to one.

### ② Deletions and survivors, each half checked at the head
All twelve deletions resolve. The ones that needed more than the body's citation:
- `devx.md` changeset pair (root `scripts/`/docs/test-only ⇒ `skip-changeset`; published source ⇒ real changeset): survives as the criterion, not the list — `os-dev.md`:297 (published = what each package's `files[]` ships; `skip-changeset` = it did not move) and :298 (the no-publish fast track), AGENTS.md step 3. The enumerated examples derive from the criterion; no rule lost.
- `devx.md` card-body-frozen pair and `spec.md` 〈席内判断〉 (comments must be read; rulings and withdrawals live in comments even when the body is decision-shaped): the mechanism survives at SKILL.md:236 (freshness gate = re-read comments later than the body's last edit) and `execution-duties.md`:11; the fact survives at SKILL.md:238 (卡上裁决评论是详注,仍是执行与复核的第一落点) and `coordinator.md`:38 (裁决记录 = 卡上裁决评论). The emptied `## 席内判断` heading in `spec.md` is rightly removed with its only line.
- `devx.md` `FETCH_HEAD` is shared → AGENTS.md:353 names `FETCH_HEAD` among the two refs that bite on the shared checkout; `devx.md`:32 keeps the prohibition.
- `devx.md` enumeration never becomes a no-op → `devx.md`:34 (anti-idle limb) and the AGENTS.md self-test section whose title is the rule.
- `spec.md` metadata format/acceptance to spec + `/meta` route → `spec.md`:13 and `server.md`:70 (both halves, each in its owning file).
- `skills.md` QA loop to `qa#1`: `qa.md`:28 carries the text/runner split and `qa.md`:2 the pointer; the half 「qa-run 记录是协议载体不是工作」 survives in sense at `qa.md`:17–19 and checklist-test SKILL.md:146 (run records carry only `qa-run`, not work labels), not as that sentence. Acceptable: the rule it stated is the label discipline, which is written.
- `skills.md` quota floor → `execution-duties.md`:120 verbatim; first-touch/four-facets/no-self-rule → `triage-duties.md`:17, SKILL.md:270, :276; finding first-touch → SKILL.md:170–171 and `skills.md`:24; PM tooling pointer and 〈路径分叉〉 pointer are pointer lines, deletable by their own words, and their targets (SKILL.md:161; :181, :186) exist.
- SKILL.md:175 rewrite: 「无主阻塞项」 is the name `dispatch-runbook.md`:173–174 uses; 「跟到底的越界面」 keeps its referent without the 「认领席」 prefix. Line-neutral at 119 B.

### ③ `server.md` L6 vs rule 2's riders
Old L6 sent every card touching `packages/spec` to the spec seat and every metadata-format change too. Rule 2 keeps the second half (as a spec child) and reverses the first for the listed riders. The new L6 (「元数据协议改动与可搭车的 `packages/spec` 改动,判据见 `spec.md`,⛔ 不另抄」) states neither rule itself and points at the one file that does, so it cannot drift. Correct, and the declared deviation (the order mapped `server.md` to L18 only) is the right call: leaving L6 would have left a red line contradicting the ruling in the lane that reads it most. `git grep` at the head finds no other 「一律归 spec」/「恒归本席」 statement in `.claude/**`.

### ④ Tier, ceilings and gates
Tier S (`.claude/**` ×5): lands on this record per the register row; the card's Execution asks nothing more of the maintainer. Ceilings at the head: SKILL.md 319/319, `devx.md` 36/36, `server.md` 86/86, `spec.md` 43/43, `skills.md` 33/33, all read from the ratchet's CEILINGS map at the head, which the diff does not touch; the devx row is 339 B and the widest row 341 B, both at their caps; no line in the four lane files exceeds 120 B. `skip-changeset` is right for a `.claude/**`-only diff; Clause-②: no and Metadata-protocol: none are consistent. 0 red check-runs on the head.

### ⑤ Recorded, no finding
- Rule 7's dashboard bullet is ruled text with no written home after this PR. Not a must-fix here: it is a triage duty whose carrier file is outside the records' named Execution files, and writing it into `triage-duties.md` would be its own ratchet payment. **The seat owes it a carrier: a line in the PR body naming where it goes (a card or the follow-up PR) before ACCEPT**, so a ruled rule does not fall between two files.
- SKILL.md:313 `Skills-docs: updated here` vs rule 5 is filed as #31555 and is out of scope here; `spec.md`:11 and SKILL.md:175 were widened into the claim by amendment 6722677217 and are reviewed above.
- The dev report names head 7beda2be; the body's gate sweep is re-run at 1d5f769c. Default-tier build under the no-Fable rule: recorded.

Must-fix: none.
